title: schc_session_table: tombstone_put/floor_put can deref NULL slot when count and scan diverge
description: lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/schc_session_table.c: both lichen_schc_tombstone_put and lichen_schc_floor_put derive the write slot from an occupancy scan that is deliberately independent of the count field (the code comments call this 'defense in depth'), but the fall-through writes slot->key/outcome/occupied with no NULL guard when count<MAX yet the scan finds no free slot (count/slot divergence) - gcc -Werror=null-dereference rejects it, so any Zephyr schc build fails. Fixed in beads-worker-7 by adding an explicit fail-closed 'if (slot == NULL) return -ENOBUFS;' after the slot-acquisition block in both functions (matches the surrounding -ENOBUFS convention); commit lands with the b7z9.93 round. Validate via the schc_session_table host test.
